WITH DriverQuarterlyStats AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_employee_id,
        strftime('%Y', delivery_date) AS year_num,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', delivery_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', delivery_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 2
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', delivery_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 3

        END AS quarter_num,
        COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT truck_id) AS distinct_trucks

    GROUP BY driver_employee_id, year_num, quarter_num
),
QualifiedDrivers AS (
    SELECT driver_employee_id
    FROM DriverQuarterlyStats
    WHERE delivered_orders >= 10 AND distinct_trucks >= 3
)
SELECT e.employee_name
FROM Employees e
WHERE e.employee_id IN (SELECT driver_employee_id FROM QualifiedDrivers)
